dedupe_keys.name: catalogue of forest fires in cyprus and state forests map department of forests open data

description: The Cyprus Department of Forests publishes on the national open data portal a catalogue of the forest fires that burned forest vegetation across Cyprus since 1 January 2010. Each record gives the fire's start date, the X and Y coordinates of its starting point, the total burned area in hectares and the possible cause, with causes such as agricultural activities, residential activities, travellers and excursionists, lightning, military activities, deliberate fires, unknown causes and cable short circuits. The catalogue is in CSV and XLSX, covers 2010 to 2023, was last modified in April 2026 and is updated annually. The same department publishes a map of the state forests of Cyprus as a shapefile, released in 2017 with temporal coverage dated July 2016. Both are free under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: the cause is the possible cause recorded, the coordinates are in a projected grid, and the pages are in Greek. Coverage is Cyprus. It supports wildfire hazard exposure analysis for power lines, roads and settlements near forests, including fires started by electrical faults, and green infrastructure planning; related records are the ICNF Portugal geocatalogue and the Buenos Aires trees in green spaces.
